full_judgment:
Mr. Md. Ruhul Amin, J: - This petition for leave to appeal has been filed against the judgment and order dated September 20, 2004 of the Administrative Appellate Tribunal in Miscellaneous Case No.17 of 2004. The Miscellaneous Case was registered upon an application filed seeking restoration of the Administrative Appellate Tribunal Appeal No.128 of 2000 which was dismissed for default on June 15, 2003. The application for restoration was filed on December 6, 2003. The Administrative Appellate Tribunal rejected the application for restoration of the Administrative Appellate Tribunal Appeal No.128 of 2000 which was dismissed for default upon observing "We find the application for restoration has not been filed within a reasonable period i.e. 90 days from the date of dismissal of the appeal. It is the usual

We called upon the learned Deputy Attorney General to place the judgment of the Administrative Tribunal and to point out in what respect the Administrative Tribunal was in error in allowing the Administrative Tribunal Case No.176 of 1997 which was allowed by the order dated August 31, 2000. The Administrative Tribunal while allowing the case held that the Respondent herein is entitled to get seniority in the service from October 19, 1977 and that she is entitled to be considered for promotion to the post of Deputy Chief prior to her juniors Opposite Party Nos.3 and 4, before the Tribunal, "subject to final approval of the gradation list by the P.S.C. Standing Committee". The learned Deputy Attorney General could not point out any error of the kind in the judgment calling for interference by the Administrative Appellate Tribunal or by this Division. In that view of the matter the application is dismissed.
